_comment: CEP 面板 HTML 里的界面文案。key = HTML 里原样的中文（空白已归一成单个空格），value = 英文。
不勾＝单开模式（展开一块自动收起其它）: Unchecked = accordion (opening one collapses the others)
① 歌词文本（LRC / SRT / ASS / 纯文本）: ① Lyrics text (LRC / SRT / ASS / plain text)
同一时间码的每行都单独建层（不限双语）: One layer per line (not just bilingual)
⑤ 模板图层（复制现有图层来生成）: ⑤ Template layer (duplicate an existing layer)
生成后隐藏模板图层（不删除）: Hide the template layer afterwards (don't delete)
图层名改成歌词: Rename layers to the lyric text
① 参考图层（从这里复制样式）: ① Reference layer (style is copied from here)
「图层样式」（投影/描边/外发光/斜面…）跟不走：要连它一起搬，选中参考层 →: Layer Styles (drop shadow / stroke / outer glow / bevel…) do NOT come along. To move them too: select the reference layer → menu "Animation > Save Animation Preset" and save as .ffx, then apply it in the Import tab ⑦.
② 应用到哪些图层: ② Which layers to apply to
③ 双语图层（原文 / 译文成对时）: ③ Bilingual layers (when original / translation are paired)
只跟参考层同组（如：只套原文）: Only the reference's own group (e.g. original only)
只另一组（如：只套译文）: Only the other group (e.g. translation only)
照抄参考层（两组会叠在一起）: Copy the reference (both groups will overlap)
文字样式（字体/大小/颜色/描边/行距/字距/对齐）: Text style (font / size / color / stroke / leading / tracking / alignment)
同时覆盖文本内容（默认不覆盖，保留各自歌词）: Also overwrite the text itself (off by default, keeps each lyric)
图层属性（混合模式/3D/运动模糊/标签色）: Layer attributes (blend mode / 3D / motion blur / label color)
无关键帧时复制静态值: Copy static values when there are no keyframes
缩放到每层的入点/出点（推荐）: Scale to each layer's in/out point (recommended)
整体平移，保持原节奏: Shift as a whole, keep the rhythm
也可以直接粘贴歌曲链接或歌曲 ID（网易云纯数字 ID / QQ songmid: You can also paste a song link or ID (NetEase numeric ID / QQ songmid)
在线通道体检（会真搜一次）: Online channel check (does a real search)
改完立刻生效，会记在面板本地。: Takes effect immediately and is remembered locally.
歌词字幕排版工具 —— 把 LRC / 纯文本歌词批量排成 After Effe: LyricSubtitleTool — batch-layout LRC / plain-text lyrics into After Effects text layers, with bilingual splitting, batch style sync and animation presets.
自检和体检的结果会打印在下面这个框里。: Self-test and channel-check results are printed in the box below.
界面语言只影响面板和脚本的提示文字；AE 自身界面不受影响。: The language setting only affects this panel and the script's own messages; After Effects' own UI is not affected.
面板顶部工具栏的「全部展开 / 全部折叠」只影响当前这一页。: The "Expand All / Collapse All" buttons only affect the current tab.
面板的设置（含语言）存在浏览器本地存储里，不会写进 .aep 工程文件。: Panel settings (including language) are stored in local storage and are never written into your .aep project.
套用 .ass 里的字幕样式: Apply the styles from the .ass file
不勾＝全部按下面的排版样式走: Unchecked = every line follows the layout settings below
PR 的时间线从 0 秒起算。这里的「整体偏移」是整条字幕往后推的时间；要对着视: Premiere timelines start at 0s. "Global offset" here is how far the whole caption track is pushed back; to line lyrics up with the music in your video, just set the offset to where the music starts.
原理：把解析结果写成 .srt → 导入项目面板的「歌词字幕工具」素材箱 → 调: How it works: the parsed result is written to .srt, imported into the "Lyric Subtitle Tool" bin in the Project panel, then Premiere's create-caption-track API is called. If the positions are off afterwards, just drag the whole caption track or adjust each caption's in/out points.
双语的原文和译文合成一条字幕: Merge original and translation into one caption (bilingual)
把 LRC / SRT / ASS / VTT / 纯文本歌词批量排成 Prem: Batch-layout LRC / SRT / ASS / VTT / plain-text lyrics into Premiere Pro caption tracks.
生成 PR 原生字幕轨：最快最稳，生成后可以在「字幕」面板里一条条改，样式由 P:
Generate Premiere native caption tracks: the fastest and most reliable route. Afterwards you can edit them one by one in the Captions panel; styling is controlled by Premiere's caption style (scripts cannot change it).
(The graphics-clip route is disabled: .mogrt files exported by Premiere itself are prgraphic, and scripts cannot write into their text. The clips do get inserted and the count is right, but the screen always shows the template placeholder.)
界面语言只影响面板和脚本的提示文字；Premiere Pro 自身界面不受影响。: The interface language only affects the panel and the script's messages; Premiere Pro's own interface is not affected.
面板的设置（含语言）存在浏览器本地存储里，不会写进 .prproj 工程文件。: Panel settings (language included) are stored in the browser's local storage; they are never written into the .prproj project file.
预览看到什么，生成出来就是什么: What you see in the preview is exactly what gets generated
